name: Composition Rule Registry
purpose: Define valid and invalid operator compositions while blocking hidden sequentialization of simultaneous aspect-binding.

composition_classes.definition: Operator composition within the same local neighborhood where domains and codomains align exactly.
Composition of projected operators where loss declaration is explicit.
Composition that implies a reduction in aspect dimensionality or simultaneity.
Composition where the codomain of the first operator does not match the domain of the second.
Attempting to compose simultaneous aspect roles into a chronological sequence without projection-loss accounting.
Composition that assumes output is identical to input without relational equivalence mapping.

mandatory_rules.rule: Composition is projection-derived unless explicitly restricted to the whole-relation core.
Composition (shadowing) cannot replace the core relation ⇔R.
Every composition must declare its domain/codomain compatibility and any associated loss.
Projected composition must explicitly declare lost simultaneity or retained structural invariants.

forbidden_claims: Associative composition derives physical law invariance.
Composition without loss recovers the whole source relation.
